title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits: Extended-Stay Elite Bonus Add-On
content:
Ashbury Rewards rewards longer stays with a stay-length add-on to the elite bonus. The stay-length add-on is ten points for a stay of seven or more nights stayed, five points for a stay of four to six nights stayed, and nothing for a shorter stay; the nights stayed are the whole calendar days from the actual check-in date to the actual check-out date, read from the stay's Room Reservations record. The add-on is added, in percentage points, to the elite bonus percentage of the member's tier. The elite bonus percentage with its add-ons is never more than 100 percent.

| Nights stayed | Stay-length add-on |
|---|---|
| 1 to 3 | None |
| 4 to 6 | 5 percentage points |
| 7 or more | 10 percentage points |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical stays)

| Actual check-in | Actual check-out | Nights stayed | Add-on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 April | 7 April | 3 | None |
| 4 April | 8 April | 4 | 5 percentage points |
| 4 April | 10 April | 6 | 5 percentage points |
| 4 April | 11 April | 7 | 10 percentage points |

A stay booked for seven nights from which the guest departed after five nights stayed carries the add-on for five nights stayed: 5 percentage points.
